snippet.title: Bye Sweet Carole - Launch Trailer | Available Now!
snippet.description:
Bye Sweet Carole is now available on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5! 🌹

Buy now: https://byesweetcarole.com/

Experience a haunting hand-drawn adventure as Bye Sweet Carole brings classic animation to life in this atmospheric narrative-horror game. Follow Lana Benton as she searches for her missing friend Carole Simmons across two haunting realms: the eerie Bunny Hall Orphanage and the mysterious Kingdom of Corolla. Solve intricate puzzles, sneak past deadly enemies, and transform into a rabbit to escape sinister threats. 

#narrativehorror #horrorgame #animatedgame #classicanimation #gaming
